events.title: Tai-chi
speaker: Jeremy Hsiao Chin SOO
events.content:
Tai Chi Yourself to Wellness with Jeremy
If you think that Tai Chi is meant only for the elderly, think again! Tai Chi is a form of low impact exercise incorporates slow, gentle movements, meditative state of mind and controlled breathing. It confers many benefits like improved balance, core strength, pain prevention and relief, and is proven to help manage chronic diseases. It is suitable for people of all age groups and it’s never too early to start! Come learn the 101s of Tai Chi from Master Jeremy – who is a passionate advocate of the ancient martial art founded in 1670!

events.title: Running

events.content:

After that, put on your running shoes and join your colleagues for an easy run around Marina Bay! You will also be joined by some of our SGMC members.

Exercise doesn’t need to be dull or a physical torture that you dread! Fun and fitness can go hand in hand!

events.title: Heartfulness Meditation
speaker: Deepak Kumar
events.content:
Heartfulness is a simple and effective set of practices for relaxation, meditation, regulating the mind, and building inner strength and attitudes to create a lasting sense of fulfilment and overall well-being.
These sessions will enable you to :
  • • Relax - Reduce tension in the body and bring yourself to a state of calm
  • • Meditate - Bring the mind to a state of focus and clarity with reduced mental haziness. Being knowledge workers, this is key to productivity and performance
  • • Rejuvenate - Let go of emotional burden, stress, anxiety, and instil lightness & joy
  • • Establish Inner Connection - Connect within and realize your inner potential
